_help: Your races, used by the Nutrition tab (race-week fuelling) and the Overview tab (countdowns and forecasts).
Copy this file to content/races.json and edit it there (races.json stays out of git).
date: race day as YYYY-MM-DD. name: anything you like. distance_km: race distance.
goal (optional): target time as h:mm:ss. The race with a goal is the one the forecast aims at.
result (optional): your finish time as h:mm:ss, added after the race. Test run results calibrate the marathon forecast.
21 km or longer: carb loading on the two days before, the race-week view opens 7 days before.
Shorter: a carb-rich day before, the view opens 3 days before.
